intro: This directive summons promising young rogues from Elwynn Forest directly into the heart of Stormwind's covert intelligence network. Directed by Keryn Sylvius in Goldshire, agents are ordered to report immediately to Renzik "The Shiv" in Old Town. Answering this summons brings an operative directly into service under Master Mathias Shaw.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Renzik was looking for you, fish.
I wouldn't keep Mathias's second in command waiting if I were you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Are you ready to get to work or do you need to take a nap before we get started?
